research_question: Can a completed I7 five-minute failed-session-auction confirmation replace only the final one-minute impulse requirement while preserving unanimous peer transfer, efficient standardized causal displacement and top-half market price discovery?

hypothesis.scdam_core: Byte-identical Candidate 13 FAR/AAC semantic policy. No SCDAM condition is relaxed.
hypothesis.session_aac: Byte-identical V4 AAC admission. The final one-minute impulse remains required because I7 acceptance and reacceptance losses were not separated by route completion alone.

session_far.local_confirmation: The frozen I7 five-minute rejection/MSS route is already complete, so the terminal one-minute impulse is not required a second time.
session_far.market_requirements: All three peers must move in the proposed direction; the candidate causal path must pass the existing efficiency and pre-event-volatility displacement floors; event direction rank must be in the top half of four markets.
session_far.countertrend_role: Candidate and median market trailing scores are adverse but not jointly severe; approve a completed countertrend transfer.
session_far.trend_resumption_role: Candidate and median market trailing scores already align with the plan and candidate trailing rank is in the top half; approve a completed session-raid trend resumption.

hypothesis.no_new_threshold: V5 reuses existing efficiency, standardized displacement, severe-adverse score and categorical top-half ranks. It adds no fitted magnitude or route whitelist.
hypothesis.portfolio: Both modules retain one GlobalCandidateMutex, one exact current-NAV 3% planned-loss sizer and one NautilusTrader account.

diagnostic_lineage.development_v4_diagnosis: V4 removed all four V3 session losses and exceeded 1% daily geometric growth, but rejected two W12 winning high-rejection plans solely because their final one-minute impulse was weak. Both winners had unanimous peers, top-half event rank and standardized path displacement above the frozen floor; the rejected W14 losing rejection was last in event and trailing rank.
